proposal.summary: Buffer overflow in NETGEAR R6400v2 before 1.0.4.118 allows remote unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code via a crafted URL to httpd.
proposal.cwe_quote: Buffer Overflow vulnerability in NETGEAR R6400v2 before version 1.0.4.118, allows remote unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted URL to httpd.

AV.quote: allows remote unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted URL to httpd.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Obtain vulnerable firmware and reproduce the issue to confirm affected component and exploitability; coordinate disclosure with NETGEAR and request patched firmware; gather proof-of-concept and full technical details for remediation.
